source: SWE-rebench tasks (CC-BY-4.0; Badertdinov et al. 2025, arXiv:2505.20411, https://huggingface.co/datasets/nebius/SWE-rebench); agent runs by Gemma-4-31B (W4A16) under the competition harness
what: audit, by a separate read-only LLM agent reading each full trace, of a sample of the self-distillation training runs kept (20) and dropped (3) by filter v2

filter_v3_rules_flag.note: counted when the v3 rules were proposed, on the runs filter v2 kept; the rules as implemented were applied to all 178 solved runs

kept_sample.reasons: Core fix (pattern-matching grammar tried last by default) matches the gold's main change; gold also reworked error reporting. Verified with a repro script, removed it, resubmitted. Never ran project tests.

Fix equals gold, but: two `read_file` calls with leaked tool-call syntax inside the path, one turn whose content is raw unparsed tool-call text (finish = stop) followed by a missing seq number, ~12 calls of aimless reading in a docstring, hit the 28-call budget, submitted without running its check ("confident"), and left `reproduce_issue.py` in the scored patch.

Extracts the remixer field like gold, but never adds it to the library item model (so it is not stored, which was the user's actual complaint), invents a new config option the issue only wished for, and never runs anything after editing.
Clean read → reproduce → edit → verify → edge cases → clean up. Equivalent to gold (empty label falls through to the existing "Empty Label" error). Four separate tiny repro files is a bit wasteful.

Fix is narrower than gold (identity check against the base decorator class instead of a subclass check). Its own repro never showed the bug; when reverting the fix still did not crash, the agent re-applied it anyway ("regardless"). Last run errored. 43-line `repro_bug.py` left in the scored patch.

Reproduced the segfault, fixed in `dataarray_to_matrix` like gold, reverted to confirm the crash returns, re-applied, cleaned up. After compaction it forgot its own scratch file name and talked about a "previous agent" — harmless but odd.

Valid alternative fix (register through the channel wrapper that already converts four args into one message object; gold changed the method signature). But the targeted test run failed and the agent dismissed it as "pre-existing" without checking — a habit we do not want to teach.

Guessed the API: sends an `ssh` body flag to the retry endpoint, while the real fix uses a separate SSH endpoint. Passes only because the test mocks `_request`. Process was otherwise tidy. Wrong-but-passing.
Uses `difflib.get_close_matches` as the issue suggests, verified with a script, removed it. About 7 calls hunting for test files.
Essentially the gold change; verified with a temporary pytest file, deleted it. Model example.
Identical to gold (raise → warning in three functions). Ran the test file; the failures were old tests that expect the old exception, and the agent said so correctly.
Removes the automatic zero-filtering as the issue proposes (made the helper public instead of deleting it). Verified, cleaned up. Repro only run after the fix.

Two `edit_file` calls with leaked syntax that the harness rejected (missing `old_string`), sent twice in a row. Turns the public `StringFormat` enum into a plain class — a wider API change than gold's one-method fix. Used all 28 calls; ~5 calls wandering for tests.

Good diagnosis and a correct fix (same logic as gold), but its verification script failed three times and never passed, the budget ran out, it submitted on "confident", left a 42-line `repro_ssh_config.py` in the scored patch, and left an unused import. Also wrote to `~/.ssh/config` outside the workspace.

The issue text already gives the fix. The agent spent ~26 calls wandering, re-found the same class after each compaction, had one failed edit, ran out of budget before running its check, and the run ends on a `submit_patch` call with no logged result and no final answer.
Reproduce → fix → verify → check other callers → clean up. Fix renames the clashing parameter (narrower than gold, which stops passing it by keyword at all) — acceptable.
Elegant equivalent fix (one minus the unknown share); reproduced, verified, ran the test file, cleaned up.
Equivalent to gold (mock objects count as methods in `_IsMethod`). Reproduced the full failure first. ~5 calls hunting for tests; a pointless ImportError guard around a standard-library import.

Guards the missing COB-ID in `PdoMap.save` and fixes the empty-map check. Gold returns early instead; the agent still writes other settings for an unconfigured PDO, which is plausible but less clean. Repro only run after the fix.
Same two changes as gold (field-name regex and group-name mapping); reproduced, verified, ran both test files. Compaction only before the final answer.

dropped_sample.verdict: Correct drop. 37 near-identical `write_file` calls in a row, each rejected by the harness for a missing parameter (rejected calls apparently do not count against the 28-call budget, so the loop ran on), 55 calls in total, scratch `repro.py` in the scored patch.

Correct under the test-file rule, but a near miss. The fix is the same as gold. A maintainer hint in the prompt told it to edit the test; it did, noticed the rule, and reverted it on the next call. The final patch is clean. Keeping it dropped is still right, because training on the run would include the test-edit turn.

dropped_sample.filter_reason: edited existing test / command may change it
dropped_sample.verdict: Correct drop. Fix matches gold, but it added a test to an existing test file, ran it, then undid it with `git checkout`. It also has a `read_file` call with a malformed argument name (an extra quote in the key), which the malformed-call rule below would catch on its own.
